input.id_order: dija-000 through dija-099 mapped to original source indices 0 through 99

seed.policy: Reset Python random, NumPy, torch and CUDA before each item using base seed + item index. Base seed 0 means item seeds 0..99 in the fixed full input order.
seed.limitation: Archived RQ1 runs report dirty trees; commit inspection does not prove the exact uncommitted runtime source. RQ2 pilot raw explicitly records item seeds 0..9.

A_iteration_bound.upstream_policy: Threshold path uses while True and exits when current generated block has no masks; steps=128 is not a hard 32-call block cap. Original generated-block termination alone does not guarantee prompt masks are filled.
A_iteration_bound.local_policy: First block jointly fills P prompt masks plus 32 generated masks, with cap P+32. Later three blocks each have cap 32. Early exit after active region is filled. Per-item worst-case bound is P+128. At least one mask is filled per successful call; mask-token proposals cause failure.
A_iteration_bound.basis: Finite completion bound derived from upstream highest-confidence-token fallback, not a value confirmed in team documentation.
